{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check the unique values in the 'severity' column
disease_severity_unique = trial_df['severity'].unique()

# Check the distribution of disease severity
severity_counts = trial_df['severity'].value_counts()

# Print results
print("Unique values in severity:", disease_severity_unique)
print("\nDistribution of severity:", severity_counts)"}
